data_fields.name: wound_roll_max
data_fields.donor_constant: roll 0..10 inclusive; wound when roll < power (chance min(power, 11) / 11)

data_fields.name: morale_loss_per_wound
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 per wound on the part, on each hit to a woundable unit

data_fields.name: accuracy_loss_per_wound
data_fields.donor_constant: 10 points per wound (head plus weapon arm)

data_fields.name: leg_tu_loss_per_wound
data_fields.donor_constant: 10 percent of base time-unit recovery, per leg wound

data_fields.name: torso_energy_loss_per_wound
data_fields.donor_constant: 10 percent of current energy, per torso wound

data_fields.name: bleed_health_per_wound_per_round
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 health per wound per turn (health -= total wounds)

data_fields.name: medikit_wound_and_health_amounts
data_fields.donor_constant: from the medical item rule (getWoundRecovery, getHealthRecovery)

best_idea: A hit that gets through armour can add one to three wounds to the struck body part, with a chance that grows with the hit's power; those wounds bleed health every round and lower accuracy, leg time-units and torso energy recovery until healed.
decision_why: The per-part wound counter and per-round bleed give a gladiator fight a lasting cost, but the donor's numbers are turn-based and it keeps wounds in the battle save only; Frankendom must set the round rate, the cap and whether wounds carry between bouts before adopting it.
acceptance: After a heavy hit to the arm, that arm shows a wound on the fighter's HUD, the fighter's next swings are less accurate, and health falls by the wound count each round; a server test asserts the wound roll for a fixed seed and that a heal item reduces only the chosen part's wounds.
